current_baseline.note: Canonical SP500 baseline for current A/B comparisons. Retained as the default after the 2026-06-20 defensive sleeve v2 review because its edge remains more stable across the full history.

csi300_baseline_relaxed.note: Tracked reference variant for CSI300 work; keep until a narrower canonical baseline replaces it.

current_baseline_defensive_sleeve_v2.note: Leading alternate baseline candidate. The refreshed 2026-06-20 run improved Sharpe, drawdown, active IR, and turnover versus current_baseline, but subperiod results were mixed, so keep it as a supported defensive profile rather than replacing the canonical default.

baseline_vs_defensive_sleeve_v2.note: Latest refreshed comparison through 2026-06-20 favored defensive_sleeve_v2 on full-window risk-adjusted and implementation metrics, but the subperiod read was mixed, so treat it as evidence for an alternate defensive profile rather than an outright baseline replacement.
